e7_s4_rejected.label: Leiomyoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Leiomyomas are typically smaller and less likely to cause significant lymph-node enlargement.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Leiomyosarcomas are rare and usually present with more aggressive features, such as larger size, irregular margins, and higher mitotic rates, which are not described in this case.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Gastric adenocarcinoma typically presents with mucosal ulceration, bleeding, or other gastrointestinal symptoms, which are absent in this patient.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Gastric carcinoid tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: Gastric carcinoid tumors are usually smaller, more superficial, and have different histological features than the mass described in this case.
